sections.title: Named for *Tanner*

image.alt: A Bravefriend collar in the grass

body: On the night of April 20th, 1999, my house caught fire while my roommate and I were sleeping. Tanner, my dog, woke me up by licking my face. I had only a few seconds to break my roommate's door down and pull him to safety. Tanner did not make it out. He gave his life to save ours, and I lost everything I had ever owned.

Family and friends carried me through. A friend suggested I put my art to work, so I drew a portrait of the singer of my favorite band, made it into a shirt, and took it to their two-night run that year. I sold every one in two days.
From those ashes I rebuilt. Brave Friend Apparel & Design has grown from band shirts into a full custom design shop, and I take a lot of pride in keeping it a small business.

quote.text: Sometimes a dog is as good as any man.
